title: Consistency error bound from acceptance and distances
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\ell:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ and $q:\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb F_2$, and choose $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and an $n\times n$ matrix $A$ over $\mathbb F_2$. The rank-one consistency error for $\gamma,A$ is at most the rejection probability of the test defined by $\ell,q$, plus twice the relative Hamming distance from $\ell$ to $x\mapsto\langle\gamma,x\rangle$, plus twice the relative Hamming distance from $q$ to the matrix character defined by $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$
